# rohanpalkar2000.github.io

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Rohan Palkar — Data Analyst</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #0F1720;
    --bg-alt: #0B121A;
    --surface: #172431;
    --surface-hi: #1E2E3D;
    --line: #29394A;
    --text: #E8EDF2;
    --text-muted: #8FA1B3;
    --accent: #2DD4BF;
    --accent-dim: #1B5C55;
    --accent-2: #F2B84B;
    --radius: 10px;
    --display: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    --body: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  }

  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}

  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation-duration:0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.01ms !important;}
  }

  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--body);
    line-height:1.6;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }

  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}

  ::selection{background:var(--accent); color:#06211E;}

  :focus-visible{
    outline:2px solid var(--accent);
    outline-offset:3px;
  }

  .wrap{
    max-width:1120px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 32px;
  }

  /* ---------- background grid texture ---------- */
  .grid-bg{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    z-index:0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(45,212,191,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:44px 44px;
    pointer-events:none;
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, black 40%, transparent 100%);
  }

  /* ---------- nav ---------- */
  header{
    position:fixed;
    top:0; left:0; right:0;
    z-index:100;
    background:rgba(15,23,32,0.82);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  nav{
    max-width:1120px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:16px 32px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .logo{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:var(--text);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
  }
  .logo::before{
    content:"";
    width:8px;height:8px;
    background:var(--accent);
    border-radius:2px;
    display:inline-block;
    box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent);
  }
  .nav-right{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:24px;
  }
  .nav-cv{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--bg);
    background:var(--accent);
    padding:8px 14px;
    border-radius:6px;
    font-weight:600;
    transition:background .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .nav-cv:hover, .nav-cv:focus-visible{background:#5eead4; transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .nav-links{
    display:flex;
    gap:28px;
    list-style:none;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13px;
  }
  .nav-links a{
    color:var(--text-muted);
    transition:color .2s ease;
    position:relative;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a:focus-visible{color:var(--accent);}
  .nav-links .idx{color:var(--accent); margin-right:2px; opacity:0.7;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; font-family:var(--mono);}

  @media (max-width:820px){
    .nav-links{
      position:fixed;
      top:57px; left:0; right:0;
      background:var(--bg-alt);
      flex-direction:column;
      padding:20px 32px;
      gap:16px;
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
      transform:translateY(-130%);
      transition:transform .3s ease;
    }
    .nav-links.open{transform:translateY(0);}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-block;}
  }

  section{
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
    padding:96px 0 40px;
  }

  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--accent);
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{
    content:"";
    width:22px; height:1px;
    background:var(--accent);
    display:inline-block;
  }

  h2.section-title{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,38px);
    font-weight:600;
    margin-bottom:40px;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }

  /* ---------- hero / terminal ---------- */
  .hero{
    padding-top:150px;
    min-height:92vh;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.15fr 0.85fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr; padding-top:120px; min-height:auto;}
  }

  .terminal{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .terminal-bar{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    padding:11px 16px;
    background:var(--surface-hi);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;}
  .dot.r{background:#e5645a;} .dot.y{background:#e0b04e;} .dot.g{background:#4fc38a;}
  .terminal-title{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--text-muted);
    margin-left:8px;
  }
  .terminal-body{
    padding:20px 22px 24px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13.5px;
  }
  .tl{white-space:pre; color:var(--text-muted);}
  .tl .kw{color:var(--accent);}
  .tl .str{color:var(--accent-2);}
  .caret{
    display:inline-block;
    width:8px; height:15px;
    background:var(--accent);
    margin-left:2px;
    animation:blink 1s step-end infinite;
    vertical-align:middle;
  }
  @keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0;}}

  .type-line{border-left:2px solid transparent; }

  .hero h1{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,58px);
    font-weight:700;
    line-height:1.05;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .hero h1 span{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero .role{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    color:var(--text-muted);
    font-size:15px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .hero p.desc{
    color:var(--text-muted);
    font-size:16px;
    max-width:52ch;
    margin-bottom:30px;
  }

  .btn-row{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .btn{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13.5px;
    padding:13px 22px;
    border-radius:7px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    transition:all .2s ease;
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
  }
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--accent);
    color:#06211E;
    border-color:var(--accent);
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{background:#5eead4; transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-ghost{color:var(--text); }
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); transform:translateY(-2px);}

  /* ---------- profile card ---------- */
  .profile-wrap{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
  }
  .profile-card{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    max-width:340px;
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:10px;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg, var(--surface-hi), var(--surface));
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  .profile-card img{
    width:100%;
    display:block;
    border-radius:11px;
    filter:saturate(1.02) contrast(1.03);
  }
  .kpi{
    position:absolute;
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:10px 14px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    box-shadow:0 15px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .kpi b{display:block; font-family:var(--display); font-size:18px; color:var(--accent);}
  .kpi.k1{top:6%; left:-14%;}
  .kpi.k2{bottom:10%; right:-16%; animation-delay:1.2s;}
  @keyframes float{
    0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}
    50%{transform:translateY(-8px);}
  }
  @media (max-width:520px){
    .kpi.k1{left:-4%;} .kpi.k2{right:-4%;}
  }

  /* ---------- experience timeline ---------- */
  .timeline{
    border-left:1px solid var(--line);
    margin-left:6px;
  }
  .trow{
    position:relative;
    padding:0 0 40px 34px;
  }
  .trow:last-child{padding-bottom:4px;}
  .trow::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    left:-6px; top:4px;
    width:11px; height:11px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--bg);
    border:2px solid var(--accent);
  }
  .trow .when{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    color:var(--accent);
    font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    margin-bottom:6px;
    display:block;
  }
  .trow h3{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:19px;
    font-weight:600;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .trow .org{
    color:var(--text-muted);
    font-size:14px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
  }
  .trow ul{
    padding-left:18px;
    color:var(--text-muted);
    font-size:14.5px;
  }
  .trow li{margin-bottom:6px;}
  .trow li::marker{color:var(--accent);}

  /* ---------- education / cert cards ---------- */
  .card-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    gap:20px;
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){.card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  .card{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:26px 26px 24px;
    transition:border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .card:hover{border-color:var(--accent-dim); transform:translateY(-3px);}
  .card .tag{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--accent);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    display:block;
  }
  .card h3{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:18px;
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .card .sub{
    color:var(--text-muted);
    font-size:13.5px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .card p{color:var(--text-muted); font-size:14px;}

  /* ---------- projects ---------- */
  .proj-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    gap:22px;
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){.proj-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .proj{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:28px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .proj:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .proj .pnum{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--text-muted);
  }
  .proj h3{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:20px;
    margin:10px 0 12px;
  }
  .proj p{color:var(--text-muted); font-size:14.5px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .proj-link{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--accent);
    margin-top:14px;
    padding-top:14px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    width:100%;
    transition:color .2s ease, gap .2s ease;
  }
  .proj-link:hover, .proj-link:focus-visible{color:#5eead4; gap:10px;}
  .chip-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;}
  .chip{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11.5px;
    padding:5px 10px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:20px;
    color:var(--text-muted);
  }

  /* ---------- skills bars ---------- */
  .skills-wrap{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:40px;
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){.skills-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .skill-row{margin-bottom:18px;}
  .skill-row .lbl{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom:7px;
  }
  .bar-track{
    height:7px;
    background:var(--surface-hi);
    border-radius:6px;
    overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .bar-fill{
    height:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-dim), var(--accent));
    width:0%;
    border-radius:6px;
    transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  }

  /* ---------- contact ---------- */
  .contact-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:40px;
    align-items:start;
  }
  @media (max-width:820px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .contact-list{list-style:none;}
  .contact-list li{
    display:flex;
    gap:14px;
    align-items:center;
    padding:14px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:14px;
  }
  .contact-list li .ico{
    width:34px; height:34px;
    border-radius:8px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    color:var(--accent);
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .contact-list a:hover{color:var(--accent);}

  form.contact-form{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:14px;
  }
  .contact-form input, .contact-form textarea{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:13px 15px;
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--body);
    font-size:14px;
  }
  .contact-form label{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom:-8px;
  }
  .contact-form textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:110px;}
  .contact-form input:focus, .contact-form textarea:focus{border-color:var(--accent);}

  footer{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:28px 0 40px;
    text-align:center;
    color:var(--text-muted);
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
  }

  .reveal{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px);
    transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;
  }
  .reveal.in{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="grid-bg"></div>

<header>
  <nav>
    <div class="logo">rohan_palkar<span style="color:var(--text-muted)">.dashboard</span></div>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
        <li><a href="#intro"><span class="idx">01</span>intro</a></li>
        <li><a href="#experience"><span class="idx">02</span>experience</a></li>
        <li><a href="#education"><span class="idx">03</span>education</a></li>
        <li><a href="#projects"><span class="idx">04</span>projects</a></li>
        <li><a href="#certifications"><span class="idx">05</span>certifications</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact"><span class="idx">06</span>contact</a></li>
      </ul>
      <a href="data:application/pdf;base64," download="Rohan_Palkar_Data_Analyst.pdf" class="nav-cv">CV ↓</a>
      <button class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" aria-label="Toggle menu">≡</button>
    </div>
  </nav>
</header>

<main class="wrap">

  <!-- HERO / INTRO -->
  <section id="intro" class="hero">
    <div>
      <div class="terminal">
        <div class="terminal-bar">
          <span class="dot r"></span><span class="dot y"></span><span class="dot g"></span>
          <span class="terminal-title">query — profile.sql</span>
        </div>
        <div class="terminal-body">
          <div class="tl"><span class="kw">SELECT</span> name, role, focus <span class="kw">FROM</span> analysts</div>
          <div class="tl"><span class="kw">WHERE</span> name = <span class="str">'Rohan Palkar'</span>;<span class="caret"></span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="eyebrow">Data Analyst · IT Officer, HDFC Bank</div>
      <h1>Turning raw data into<br><span>decisions that hold up.</span></h1>
      <p class="role">Thane, Maharashtra — Python · SQL · Power BI · Tableau</p>
      <p class="desc">I build the pipeline between messy data and confident decisions — cleaning it, modelling it, and putting it in front of people as dashboards they'll actually use. Currently securing systems by day at HDFC Bank, and shipping analytics projects on the side.</p>
      <div class="btn-row">
        <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-primary">Get in touch →</a>
        <a href="data:application/pdf;base64," download="Rohan_Palkar_Data_Analyst.pdf" class="btn btn-ghost">Download CV ↓</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="profile-wrap">
      <div class="profile-card">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Rohan Palkar in an office corridor" />
        <div class="kpi k1"><b>2+ yrs</b>professional exp.</div>
        <div class="kpi k2"><b>5+</b>certifications &amp; projects</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- EXPERIENCE -->
  <section id="experience">
    <div class="eyebrow">02 — Work log</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Experience</h2>

    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="trow reveal">
        <span class="when">JUN 2025 — TILL DATE</span>
        <h3>IT Officer</h3>
        <span class="org">HDFC Bank</span>
        <ul>
          <li>Run Vulnerability Assessment &amp; Penetration Testing (VAPT) across web apps, networks, and systems.</li>
          <li>Write VAPT reports covering vulnerability description, impact, CVSS score, proof of concept, and remediation steps.</li>
          <li>Perform network scanning and enumeration to surface open ports, services, and misconfigurations.</li>
          <li>Prioritise vulnerabilities by severity and business impact, and work with application teams to close them out.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="trow reveal">
        <span class="when">AUG 2024 — FEB 2025</span>
        <h3>Machine Learning Engineer Intern</h3>
        <span class="org">Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital</span>
        <ul>
          <li>Implemented predictive ML models in Python, lifting early disease-detection accuracy by 15% and cutting diagnostic errors by 10%.</li>
          <li>Deployed AI/ML models for medical diagnostics, improving diagnostic accuracy by 20% for patient outcomes.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="trow reveal">
        <span class="when">NOV 2023 — JUN 2024</span>
        <h3>Data Analyst Intern</h3>
        <span class="org">Cynthi'ans Edutech Pvt. Ltd.</span>
        <ul>
          <li>Prepared datasets and designed ER diagrams, surfacing three key insights that shaped business strategy.</li>
          <li>Analysed and visualised trends across tools, improving decision-making efficiency by 15% through detailed reporting.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- EDUCATION -->
  <section id="education">
    <div class="eyebrow">03 — Coursework</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Education</h2>
    <div class="card-grid">
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="tag">In progress</span>
        <h3>MBA, Operations &amp; Data Science</h3>
        <div class="sub">NMIMS University · Jan 2026 – Dec 2027</div>
        <p>Graduate coursework bridging operations strategy with applied data science.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="tag">CGPA 8.23</span>
        <h3>M.Sc. Information Technology (AI)</h3>
        <div class="sub">University of Mumbai · Aug 2022 – Aug 2024</div>
        <p>Specialised in artificial intelligence within an IT postgraduate program.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal">
        <span class="tag">CGPA 9.25</span>
        <h3>B.Sc. Information Technology</h3>
        <div class="sub">University of Mumbai · Jul 2018 – May 2021</div>
        <p>Foundational degree covering core information technology disciplines.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- PROJECTS -->
  <section id="projects">
    <div class="eyebrow">04 — Selected builds</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Projects</h2>
    <div class="proj-grid">
      <div class="proj reveal">
        <span class="pnum">FEB 2025</span>
        <h3>Zomato Restaurant Analysis</h3>
        <p>Analysed 9,551 restaurants across 15 countries and 141 cities, then delivered an interactive Power BI dashboard covering cuisine distribution, pricing, ratings, and customer preferences to inform business strategy.</p>
        <div class="chip-row">
          <span class="chip">Power BI</span><span class="chip">SQL</span><span class="chip">Tableau</span><span class="chip">Excel</span>
        </div>
        <a href="https://github.com/rohanpalkar2000/Zomato-Restaurant-Analysis" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="proj-link">View on GitHub →</a>
      </div>
      <div class="proj reveal">
        <span class="pnum">OCT 2024</span>

<script>
  // mobile nav toggle
  const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => navLinks.classList.toggle('open'));
  navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => navLinks.classList.remove('open')));

  // scroll reveal
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => { if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
  }, {threshold:0.15});
  revealEls.forEach(el => io.observe(el));

  // skill bars animate on view
  const bars = document.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill');
  const barIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.width = e.target.dataset.w + '%';
        barIO.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:0.3});
  bars.forEach(b => barIO.observe(b));

  // contact form -> mailto
  document.querySelector('.contact-form').addEventListener('submit', function(){
    const name = document.getElementById('cname').value;
    const email = document.getElementById('cemail').value;
    const msg = document.getElementById('cmsg').value;
    const body = encodeURIComponent(`From: ${name} (${email})\n\n${msg}`);
    window.location.href = `mailto:rohanpalkar2000@gmail.com?subject=Portfolio contact from ${encodeURIComponent(name)}&body=${body}`;
  });
</script>
